name: kit-statusbar
description: A status bar for Claude Code in the desktop app and the CLI: repo, model, effort, context, account, session title, 5-hour and weekly limits.

surfaces.title: Where to draw the band
surfaces.description: auto: in the Claude desktop app always, and in the terminal when no status line is set up there (so you never see the same facts twice); with one, it asks once whether to show both and saves the answer here. desktop: the desktop app only. desktop+terminal: both, always.

weeklyBudgetPerDay.title: Weekly budget per day (%)
weeklyBudgetPerDay.description: Share of the weekly limit you plan to use per day, current day included, shown next to the weekly bar. 14 is an even spread over 7 days. 0 or less hides the budget.

showEmail.title: Show the account email
showEmail.description: Shown by default. Turn off before screen-sharing or screenshots. The plugin then does not look the email up at all.

showTitle.title: Show the session title
showTitle.description: The /rename name, else the automatic title, read from this session's own transcript. Turn off before screen-sharing if titles can be sensitive.

showLimits.title: Show the 5-hour and weekly limits
showLimits.description: The row is hidden on its own when there is no rate-limit data (API key or third-party provider).

maxTranscriptMB.title: Largest transcript to read (MB)
maxTranscriptMB.description: How much of the session transcript is looked at to find its title. The module reads up to 4 MB itself; a larger transcript is read from its end by the optional Node helper, up to this many MB. Without Node the last known title stays.
